_comment: Fixture manifest for the KERNEL_VERSION gate (#1247). Pinned at kernel.v2: sha256 of each deterministic golden fixture output, and the KERNEL_VERSION those bytes were pinned at. version.selfcheck.mjs recomputes every fixture and compares it to the bytes pinned here. When the engine changes behaviour (fixture bytes move), the same commit must bump KERNEL_VERSION in version.js AND refresh this manifest. Do not weaken the hashes to land feel work.
